Hello everyone, it’s Mav!
First, I want to welcome you to the official SML25 stats sheet! I’m so happy and proud of the community for coming together and making Legacy possible again.
Second, I want to apologize for the wait I had planned to release this last week, but work got busy and I had to put it on hold for a bit. I felt bad, so I decided to just release it today and stop gatekeeping a little.
The sheet is mostly done, but I’ll be adding more over the season. Pro stats will be out tomorrow or Friday.
DM me if you have any suggestions. If it’s something stupid, I’ll change your stats :)
